name: enrich-work-item
description: Apply type-specific enricher prompts to produce team-format Epic, Feature, User Story, or Task documentation; persist on approval. When source is a tracker link or id, ingests work-item fields, attachments, and description-referenced documents before enrichment.

work_item_type.description: Vendor-neutral work item type to enrich

source.description: URL (tracker work-item link or external doc), local path, or inline text to enrich. Tracker sources trigger attachment and description-reference resolution through tracker_get_work_item.

parent.description: Parent work item id or URL for hierarchy context. Optional when source is the tracker — defaults to the fetched item's parent.

attachment.description: Additional documentation URL or path, merged with any attachments discovered on a tracker source work item
